en: The weather was perfect for our class picnic at the park last Saturday.
exzh: 上週六的天氣對我們班在公園的野餐來說再完美不過了。

en: Amy accidentally dropped her phone into the sink while washing the dishes.
exzh: Amy洗碗時不小心把手機掉進了水槽。

en: Ben felt embarrassed when his shoes made a loud noise in the quiet library.
exzh: Ben的鞋子在安靜的圖書館裡發出很大的聲音，讓他覺得很尷尬。

en: Lisa was depressed after she failed the math quiz again.
exzh: Lisa數學小考又不及格，之後心情很沮喪。

en: Kevin suddenly realized that he had left his lunch box on the bus.
exzh: Kevin突然意識到自己把便當盒忘在公車上了。

en: On Dragon Boat Festival, my grandmother makes traditional rice dumplings for the whole family.
exzh: 端午節時，奶奶會為全家人做傳統的粽子。

en: Fortunately, Mr. Chen gave us two more days to finish the science report.
exzh: 幸好陳老師多給了我們兩天時間完成自然科報告。

en: Finishing a long project and handing it in on time is a satisfying feeling.
exzh: 完成一份很長的專題並準時交出去，是一種令人滿足的感覺。

en: At the first club meeting, Amy will introduce the new members to everyone.
exzh: 在第一次社團聚會上，Amy會向大家介紹新社員。

en: Ben left a short message on the board to tell us the meeting time.
exzh: Ben在布告欄上留了一則簡短的訊息，告訴我們開會時間。

en: Kevin put his phone away so he could focus on his English homework.
exzh: Kevin把手機收起來，這樣才能專心寫英文作業。

en: Lisa tried to ignore the noise from the street and kept studying.
exzh: Lisa試著不理會街上的噪音，繼續讀書。

en: Please pay attention to the teacher when she explains the new rules.
exzh: 老師說明新規則時，請專心聽。

en: Amy was disappointed because the basketball game was canceled by the rain.
exzh: Amy很失望，因為籃球賽被大雨取消了。

en: The principal personally thanked each student who helped clean the school yard.
exzh: 校長親自感謝每一位幫忙打掃校園的學生。

en: We saw an amazing sunrise from the top of the mountain this morning.
exzh: 今天早上我們在山頂看到了令人驚嘆的日出。

en: Ben was sick yesterday; therefore, he missed the whole day of school.
exzh: Ben昨天生病了，因此整天都沒去上學。

en: Kevin took a different road to avoid the heavy traffic near the school.
exzh: Kevin改走另一條路，以避開學校附近的塞車。

en: The distance between my house and the school is only about two kilometers.
exzh: 我家和學校之間的距離只有大約兩公里。

en: Our flight to Tokyo leaves at seven, so we must get up early.
exzh: 我們飛往東京的航班七點起飛，所以得早起。

en: Some small plants can survive in the desert with very little water.
exzh: 有些小型植物只靠極少的水就能在沙漠中存活。

en: Lisa checked every item on her list before leaving for the school trip.
exzh: Lisa在出發去校外教學前，檢查了清單上的每一個項目。

en: The nurse told Amy to clean the infected finger with water and then cover it with a bandage.
exzh: 護理師要Amy用清水清洗那根受感染的手指，再包上繃帶。

en: Our art class will create a big poster for the school festival.
exzh: 我們的美術課要為校慶製作一張大海報。

en: Ben bought the complete set of science books for his little brother.
exzh: Ben為弟弟買了整套完整的科學書。

en: The students eagerly waited outside the gym for the game to start.
exzh: 學生們在體育館外熱切地等著比賽開始。

en: The night market was so crowded that we could hardly walk through it.
exzh: 夜市擠得我們幾乎沒辦法走過去。

en: Kevin obviously studied hard, because he got every answer right on the test.
exzh: Kevin顯然很用功，因為他考試每一題都答對。

en: Our class has a recycling box for old paper and plastic bottles.
exzh: 我們班有一個放舊紙張和塑膠瓶的資源回收箱。

en: Lisa joined a club that cleans the beach to protect the environment.
exzh: Lisa參加了一個清理海灘的社團來保護環境。

en: Amy washed her hands properly before helping her mother cook dinner.
exzh: Amy在幫媽媽煮晚餐前，把手好好地洗乾淨。

en: Ben likes the freedom of choosing his own club activities after school.
exzh: Ben喜歡放學後可以自由選擇社團活動。

en: Kevin held the rope firmly while his friend climbed up the wall.
exzh: 朋友攀爬岩壁時，Kevin牢牢地抓住繩子。

en: On our trip to Tainan, we visited an ancient temple with a long history.
exzh: 我們去台南旅行時，參觀了一座歷史悠久的古老廟宇。

en: Lisa thought it was unfair that only some students could use the new room.
exzh: Lisa覺得只有部分學生能使用新教室很不公平。

en: The vet gave special treatment to the dog that hurt its leg.
exzh: 獸醫給了那隻腿受傷的狗特別的治療。

en: Amy plays the violin, and it is her favorite instrument.
exzh: Amy會拉小提琴，那是她最喜愛的樂器。

en: Ben was happy to receive a letter from his friend in Canada.
exzh: Ben很高興收到加拿大朋友寄來的信。

en: Amy likes swimming; similarly, her sister enjoys water sports.
exzh: Amy喜歡游泳，同樣地，她姊姊也喜歡水上運動。

en: Kevin took a deep breath and aimed carefully at the center of the target.
exzh: Kevin深吸一口氣，仔細瞄準靶心。

en: Lisa gladly accepted her neighbor's offer to drive her to the station.
exzh: Lisa欣然接受鄰居開車送她去車站的提議。

en: At my part-time job, I always greet each customer with a smile.
exzh: 在我的兼職工作中，我總是微笑著招呼每一位顧客。

en: After many tries, Ben eventually learned how to ride a bike.
exzh: 試了很多次之後，Ben終於學會騎腳踏車了。

en: Mr. Chen warned us that the last question on the test was a trap.
exzh: 陳老師提醒我們，考卷的最後一題是個陷阱。

en: Amy is a clever girl who can solve difficult puzzles very quickly.
exzh: Amy是個聰明的女孩，能很快解開困難的謎題。

en: Kevin wrote a detailed report about how plants grow in different light.
exzh: Kevin寫了一份詳細的報告，說明植物在不同光線下如何生長。

en: Lisa found it hard to express her feelings in English at first.
exzh: Lisa起初覺得很難用英文表達自己的感受。

en: Ben asked his classmates for their opinion about the school trip plan.
exzh: Ben詢問同學們對校外教學計畫的意見。

en: Amy put a lot of effort into practicing for the school dance contest.
exzh: Amy為了學校的舞蹈比賽投入了很多心力練習。

en: In Taiwan, it is a custom to eat rice cakes during the New Year.
exzh: 在台灣，過年吃年糕是一種習俗。

en: Kevin joined the exchange program to learn about the culture of Japan.
exzh: Kevin參加交換計畫，以了解日本的文化。

en: Lisa keeps her grandfather's old watch because it is very valuable to her.
exzh: Lisa保存著爺爺的舊手錶，因為對她來說非常珍貴。

en: When we turned on the light, the little mouse quickly disappeared.
exzh: 我們一開燈，那隻小老鼠就很快消失了。

en: Ben writes a few sentences in his daily diary before going to bed.
exzh: Ben睡前會在他的日記裡寫幾句話。

en: The price of the school trip includes meals, tickets, and the bus ride.
exzh: 校外教學的費用包含餐點、門票和遊覽車。

en: Amy could see a big difference between the two science experiments.
exzh: Amy看得出這兩個自然科實驗之間有很大的差異。

en: Mr. Chen always keeps a positive attitude, even when the class is noisy.
exzh: 就算班上很吵，陳老師也總是保持積極的態度。

en: Lisa listens to English songs every day to improve her listening skills.
exzh: Lisa每天聽英文歌來提升她的聽力。

en: Kevin looks quiet, but he actually loves telling jokes to his friends.
exzh: Kevin看起來很安靜，其實他很愛對朋友講笑話。

en: Ben's goal this year is to finish a ten-kilometer run with his team.
exzh: Ben今年的目標是和隊友一起跑完十公里。

en: It was an ordinary Monday, but Amy got a surprise gift from her friend.
exzh: 那只是個平凡的星期一，但Amy卻收到朋友送的驚喜禮物。

en: The school holds a fun activity every spring to help students make friends.
exzh: 學校每年春天都會舉辦有趣的活動，幫助學生交朋友。

en: The strong wind caused serious damage to the trees around our school.
exzh: 強風對我們學校周圍的樹木造成了嚴重的損壞。

en: Lisa used her phone to record the teacher's explanation of the experiment.
exzh: Lisa用手機錄下老師對實驗的講解。

en: Kevin believes that hard work is the key to success in school.
exzh: Kevin相信努力是在學校成功的關鍵。

en: Ben felt a sharp pain in his leg after the soccer game.
exzh: Ben踢完足球賽後，腿部感到一陣劇痛。

en: When the bell rang, Amy immediately packed her bag and ran outside.
exzh: 鈴聲一響，Amy立刻收好書包跑了出去。

en: It takes a lot of courage to give a speech in front of the whole school.
exzh: 在全校面前演講需要很大的勇氣。

en: Lisa's parents gave her strong support when she joined the science contest.
exzh: Lisa參加科學競賽時，父母給了她很大的支持。

en: Students should show respect to their teachers and classmates.
exzh: 學生應該對老師和同學表示尊重。

en: Kevin felt a lot of pressure before the big English exam.
exzh: 大型英文考試前，Kevin感到壓力很大。

en: Amy normally gets up at six, but today she slept until seven.
exzh: Amy通常六點起床，但今天睡到了七點。

en: Ben measured the water accurately so that his experiment would work well.
exzh: Ben把水量得很精準，好讓他的實驗順利進行。

en: Don't blame Kevin for the broken window; it was an accident.
exzh: 別為了破掉的窗戶責怪Kevin，那只是意外。

en: Lack of sleep can affect how well you do at school.
exzh: 睡眠不足會影響你在學校的表現。

en: The graph in our science book indicates that the temperature is rising.
exzh: 我們自然課本裡的圖表顯示氣溫正在上升。

en: The school will provide free lunch for students who join the weekend camp.
exzh: 學校會為參加週末營隊的學生提供免費午餐。

en: We had a pleasant walk along the river after the exam.
exzh: 考完試後，我們沿著河邊度過了愉快的散步時光。

en: Amy desperately searched her bag for the ticket before the bus left.
exzh: 公車開走前，Amy拚命地在書包裡找車票。

en: Ben reluctantly got up early to help his father at the market.
exzh: Ben勉強地早起去市場幫爸爸的忙。

en: Lisa tried to describe the beautiful lake she saw on the trip.
exzh: Lisa試著描述她在旅行中看到的美麗湖泊。

en: Mr. Chen will explain how the machine works in tomorrow's science class.
exzh: 陳老師會在明天的自然課解釋這台機器如何運作。

en: Kevin was so tired after practice that he could hardly keep his eyes open.
exzh: Kevin練習完累到幾乎睜不開眼睛。

en: The female cat in our neighborhood just had four little kittens.
exzh: 我們社區那隻母貓剛生了四隻小貓。

en: Amy wants to continue practicing the piano after school every day.
exzh: Amy 想要每天放學後繼續練習鋼琴。

en: Good education helps students find jobs they enjoy when they grow up.
exzh: 良好的教育能幫助學生長大後找到自己喜歡的工作。

en: The principal shook hands with every student at the school gate this morning.
exzh: 校長今天早上在校門口和每位學生握手。

en: Mr. Chen gives every student an equal chance to speak in class.
exzh: 陳老師讓每位學生在課堂上都有平等的發言機會。

en: Ben tried to control his nerves before the speech contest began.
exzh: Ben 在演講比賽開始前努力控制自己的緊張情緒。

en: Lisa needs two weeks to recover from her broken leg before playing basketball.
exzh: Lisa 需要兩週時間從腿傷中復原，才能再打籃球。

en: Please sign your name at the bottom of the permission slip, Kevin.
exzh: Kevin，請在同意書最下方簽上你的名字。

en: Amy consistently gets up at six to review her lessons before school.
exzh: Amy 總是在六點起床，於上學前複習功課。

en: Kevin delivers newspapers to the neighbors every morning before going to school.
exzh: Kevin 每天早上上學前都會送報紙給鄰居。

en: It is rude to look at your phone while your grandma is talking.
exzh: 奶奶說話時看手機是很沒禮貌的。

en: Ben purposely sat in the front row so he could see the board clearly.
exzh: Ben 故意坐在第一排，這樣才能把黑板看清楚。

en: Lisa was genuinely happy when her team won the school dance contest.
exzh: Lisa 的隊伍贏得校內舞蹈比賽時，她是真心感到開心。

en: The classroom gradually became quiet after the teacher walked in.
exzh: 老師走進來後，教室逐漸安靜了下來。

en: Amy was absolutely sure she had put her homework in her bag.
exzh: Amy 完全確定自己把作業放進書包了。

en: Kevin went to seek help from Mr. Chen after the math class.
exzh: Kevin 數學課後去向陳老師尋求協助。

en: Ben finds science class increasingly interesting as the experiments get harder.
exzh: 隨著實驗越來越難，Ben 覺得自然課越來越有趣。

en: The river near our school is very broad, so a bridge is needed.
exzh: 我們學校附近的河非常寬闊，所以需要一座橋。

en: Our club members meet every Friday to discuss plans for the school festival.
exzh: 我們社團成員每週五聚會，討論校慶的計畫。

en: Lisa has a good method for remembering English words: she draws little pictures.
exzh: Lisa 有個背英文單字的好方法：她會畫小圖。

en: Amy did not expect so many classmates to come to her birthday party.
exzh: Amy 沒料到會有這麼多同學來參加她的生日派對。

en: Ben was curious about how the machine in the science lab worked.
exzh: Ben 對科學實驗室裡那台機器如何運作感到好奇。

en: The sports day is the biggest event of the year at our school.
exzh: 運動會是我們學校一年中最大的活動。

en: Kevin always gives his seat to an elder on the MRT.
exzh: Kevin 在捷運上總是會讓座給年長者。

en: Lisa will arrange a trip to Tainan for our class this summer.
exzh: Lisa 將為我們班安排今年夏天去台南的旅行。

en: Our team kept a strong spirit even though we lost the baseball game.
exzh: 雖然我們輸了棒球比賽，團隊仍保持著堅強的精神。

en: Mr. Chen gave us a general idea of the test before class ended.
exzh: 陳老師在下課前給我們說明了考試的大致內容。

en: The little dog ran to chase the ball across the school playground.
exzh: 小狗跑過學校操場去追那顆球。

en: Amy digitally signed up for the English contest on the school website.
exzh: Amy 在學校網站上以數位方式報名了英文比賽。

en: My little brother constantly asks me to play video games with him.
exzh: 我弟弟老是不斷要我陪他打電動。

en: Our club will repair the existing desks instead of buying new ones.
exzh: 我們社團會修理現有的桌子，而不是買新的。

en: Typically, Ben eats a bowl of noodles for lunch in the school cafeteria.
exzh: Ben 通常在學校餐廳午餐吃一碗麵。

en: The news about the school trip spread quickly among all the students.
exzh: 關於校外旅行的消息很快就在全校學生之間傳開了。

en: Lisa was the host of the singing contest at our school last week.
exzh: Lisa 是上週我們學校歌唱比賽的主持人。

en: Grandma gave Amy an exquisite little box made of wood for her birthday.
exzh: 奶奶送給 Amy 一個精緻的小木盒當作生日禮物。

en: Kevin was starving after the long basketball practice, so he ate three rice balls.
exzh: 長時間的籃球練習後 Kevin 餓壞了，所以吃了三個飯糰。

en: Ben has so much energy that he runs to school every morning.
exzh: Ben 精力十足，每天早上都跑步去上學。

en: Students are not allowed in this restricted area of the science building.
exzh: 學生不可進入科學大樓這個管制區域。

en: Amy hopes to gain more confidence by joining the school drama club.
exzh: Amy 希望藉由參加學校戲劇社來增加自信。

en: Our school has a new system for borrowing books from the library.
exzh: 我們學校有一套新的圖書館借書系統。

en: Mr. Chen wrote the abbreviation PE on the board and asked what it meant.
exzh: 陳老師在黑板上寫下縮寫 PE，問大家是什麼意思。

en: Kevin turned in a blank answer sheet because he could not answer any of the questions.
exzh: Kevin 交出了一張空白的答案卷，因為他一題都答不出來。

en: Our guide in Taipei showed us the best night markets to visit.
exzh: 我們在台北的導遊帶我們去看最值得逛的夜市。

en: Lisa and Amy review their notes together at the library every weekend.
exzh: Lisa 和 Amy 每個週末都在圖書館一起複習筆記。

en: Ben added powdered milk to his tea at the school breakfast shop.
exzh: Ben 在學校早餐店的茶裡加了奶粉。

en: In science class, we watched the liquid metal slowly turn into a solid.
exzh: 在自然課上，我們看著液態金屬慢慢變成固體。

en: Kevin regularly goes swimming with his father on Sunday mornings.
exzh: Kevin 每週日早上都會固定和爸爸去游泳。

en: All the club members gather in the music room at four o'clock.
exzh: 所有社員在四點整聚集到音樂教室。

en: Mom decided to limit my screen time to one hour on school nights.
exzh: 媽媽決定把我上學日晚上的使用螢幕時間限制在一小時內。

en: The bubble tea shop will employ two students to work on weekends.
exzh: 這家手搖飲店將僱用兩名學生在週末打工。

en: Amy missed the school trip because of a short illness last week.
exzh: Amy 因為上週生了一場小病而錯過了校外旅行。

en: Lisa improved tremendously in math after studying with her cousin all summer.
exzh: Lisa 整個暑假和表哥一起讀書後，數學進步了非常多。

en: Kevin's grandfather is frail now, so he walks slowly with a cane.
exzh: Kevin 的爺爺現在身體虛弱，所以拄著拐杖慢慢走。

en: Ben had to refuse the invitation because he had a test the next day.
exzh: Ben 因為隔天要考試，只好拒絕這個邀約。

en: Dad promised to take us to the beach if we finish our homework.
exzh: 爸爸答應我們，只要寫完功課就帶我們去海邊。

en: Amy and Ben collaborate on a science project about solar energy.
exzh: Amy 和 Ben 合作進行一項關於太陽能的自然科專題。

en: The test this time was slightly harder than the one last month.
exzh: 這次的考試比上個月的稍微難一點。

en: Lisa borrowed a library book about the universe, stars, and planets.
exzh: Lisa 從圖書館借了一本關於宇宙、星星和行星的書。

en: Kevin is generous and often shares his snacks with the whole class.
exzh: Kevin 很大方，常常和全班同學分享他的零食。

en: The teacher did not punish Ben because he told the truth about the broken window.
exzh: 老師沒有處罰 Ben，因為他誠實說出了窗戶破掉的事。

en: In the story we read, the king decided to banish the thief from the town.
exzh: 在我們讀的故事裡，國王決定把小偷驅逐出城。

en: The leaves began to rustle in the wind as we walked up the mountain.
exzh: 我們爬山時，樹葉在風中開始沙沙作響。

en: Amy previously lived in Kaohsiung before her family moved to Taipei.
exzh: Amy 在全家搬到台北之前，曾經住在高雄。

en: The view from the top of Yushan was breathtaking, and we took many photos.
exzh: 從玉山山頂看出去的景色壯觀得令人屏息，我們拍了很多照片。

en: Lisa wore a stunning blue dress to the school dance.
exzh: Lisa 穿著一件美得驚人的藍色洋裝參加學校舞會。

en: Ben's knee was bruised after he fell during the soccer game.
exzh: Ben 在足球賽中跌倒後，膝蓋瘀青了。

en: Mr. Chen knows our school's old buildings intimately because he has worked here for thirty years.
exzh: 陳老師在這裡工作了三十年，對學校的老建築非常熟悉。

en: Amy skillfully fixed the broken chair with only a few tools.
exzh: Amy 只用了幾樣工具就熟練地修好了壞掉的椅子。

en: We followed a narrow path through the park to reach the lake.
exzh: 我們沿著公園裡的一條小徑走到湖邊。

en: Kevin was surprised by the smoothness of the new road near his home.
exzh: Kevin 對家附近新馬路的平坦感到很驚訝。

en: Lisa initially thought the math problem was easy, but then she made a mistake.
exzh: Lisa 起初覺得那道數學題很簡單，但後來她算錯了。

en: The lights in our classroom turn on automatically when it gets dark.
exzh: 天色變暗時，我們教室的燈會自動亮起。

en: Mr. Chen said it is wrong to park a bike illegally in front of shops.
exzh: 陳老師告訴我們，把腳踏車違規停在店門口是不對的。

en: The hot summer sun shone mercilessly on us during the long school run.
exzh: 在漫長的校內路跑中，夏日的烈陽毫不留情地照在我們身上。

en: Be careful not to let the ball strike the window of the classroom.
exzh: 小心別讓球打到教室的窗戶。

en: After the long hike, Amy fell asleep on the bus from exhaustion.
exzh: 長途健行後，Amy 因為筋疲力盡在公車上睡著了。

en: Kevin's grandmother made a pilgrimage to a famous temple with her friends last spring.
exzh: Kevin 的奶奶去年春天和朋友們去了一趟知名廟宇朝聖。

en: A throng of students waited outside the gym to buy tickets for the concert.
exzh: 一大群學生在體育館外排隊等著買音樂會的票。

en: Ben accidentally pierced the balloon with a pen during the party.
exzh: Ben 在派對上不小心用筆把氣球刺破了。

en: The whole class clapped enthusiastically when Lisa finished her speech.
exzh: Lisa 講完演講時，全班熱烈地鼓掌。

en: Mr. Chen will designate Amy as the leader of our science group.
exzh: 陳老師會指定 Amy 擔任我們自然科小組的組長。

en: On our trip to Kenting, we saw colorful fish swimming around a coral reef.
exzh: 我們去墾丁旅行時，看到五顏六色的魚在珊瑚礁周圍游來游去。

en: Kevin likes to flex his arm muscles after lifting weights at the gym.
exzh: Kevin 在健身房舉完重量後，喜歡彎曲手臂展示肌肉。

en: The test was relatively easy, so most of the students finished early.
exzh: 這次考試相對簡單，所以大部分學生都提早寫完。

en: The temperature dropped suddenly, so Amy put on her jacket before going out.
exzh: 氣溫突然下降，所以 Amy 出門前穿上了外套。

en: Amy wears a helmet to protect her head when she rides her bike to school.
exzh: Amy 騎腳踏車上學時會戴安全帽來保護頭部。

en: Our biology teacher said colony collapse disorder is making many bee hives suddenly die out.
exzh: 我們的生物老師解釋說，蜂群崩潰失調症正導致許多蜂巢突然死亡。

en: Kevin's grandfather stopped using pesticide on his vegetables to keep the garden safe for bees.
exzh: Kevin 的爺爺不再對蔬菜噴灑農藥，因為他希望菜園對蜜蜂更安全。

en: Bees fly from flower to flower to pollinate the fruit trees behind Lisa's house.
exzh: 蜜蜂在花朵間飛來飛去，為 Lisa 家後面的果樹授粉。

zh: 負擔得起的；價格合理的
en: Ben found an affordable hotel near the night market for his family trip to Tainan.
exzh: Ben 為家人的台南之旅在夜市附近找到一間價格合理的旅館。

zh: 毀滅性的；極具破壞力的
en: The typhoon had a devastating effect on the farms in our town.
exzh: 那場颱風對我們鎮上的農田造成毀滅性的影響。

en: Mr. Chen said Kevin is responsible for cleaning the science lab this week.
exzh: Mr. Chen 說這週 Kevin 負責打掃自然科實驗室。

en: Our school garden club grows vegetables sustainably, so the soil stays healthy for many years.
exzh: 我們學校的園藝社以永續的方式種菜，所以土壤能多年保持健康。

en: The class will debate whether students should have a shorter lunch break on Fridays.
exzh: 全班要辯論學生星期五的午休時間是否應該縮短。

en: Amy insisted on walking home with her little brother even though it was raining.
exzh: 儘管下著雨，Amy 還是堅持要和弟弟一起走路回家。

en: We took photos on the arched stone bridge during our school trip to Jiufen.
exzh: 我們到九份校外教學時，在拱形石橋上拍了照。

en: Mr. Lin used a small machine to project the science video onto the classroom wall.
exzh: Mr. Lin 用一台小機器把自然科影片投射到教室牆上。

en: Ben works at a bakery on weekends, and the income helps him pay for cram school.
exzh: Ben 週末在麵包店打工，這份收入幫他付補習班的費用。

en: Lisa made great progress in math after she practiced every night with her sister.
exzh: Lisa 每晚和姊姊一起練習後，數學進步很多。

en: The museum showed us the development of Taiwan's trains from steam engines to high-speed rail.
exzh: 博物館讓我們看到台灣火車從蒸汽火車到高鐵的發展。

en: The campers followed a map and finally found the treasure under a big tree.
exzh: 夏令營的孩子們照著地圖走，終於在一棵大樹下找到了寶藏。

en: Our school is situated at the foot of a mountain, so the air is always fresh.
exzh: 我們學校位於山腳下，所以空氣總是很清新。

en: Kevin is adventurous, so he was the first to try the tallest water slide.
exzh: Kevin 很愛冒險，所以他第一個去玩最高的滑水道。

en: Amy keeps a private diary in her desk, and she doesn't let anyone read it.
exzh: Amy 在書桌裡放了一本私人日記，不讓任何人看。

en: At the night market, Lisa sampled three kinds of fruit tea before choosing one.
exzh: 在夜市裡，Lisa 試喝了三種水果茶之後才選了一種。

en: Ben's bike tire burst on the way to school, so he had to walk the rest.
exzh: Ben 的腳踏車輪胎在上學途中爆胎了，所以剩下的路他只好用走的。

en: We visited an isolated village in the mountains where there was no phone signal.
exzh: 我們參觀了山裡一個偏遠的村莊，那裡沒有手機訊號。

en: Mr. Chen is a selfless teacher who often stays late to help students.
exzh: Mr. Chen 是一位無私的老師，常常留得很晚來幫助學生。

en: The test was merely a small quiz, so Ben didn't need to worry about it.
exzh: 那只不過是一個小考，所以 Ben 不需要擔心。

en: The goalkeeper moved swiftly to the left and stopped the ball.
exzh: 守門員迅速地往左移動，擋下了球。

en: Lisa retraced her steps from the gym to the classroom to look for her lost keys.
exzh: Lisa 從體育館走回教室，沿路折返尋找她弄丟的鑰匙。

en: Ben can handle a busy lunch hour at his part-time job at the noodle shop.
exzh: Ben 能應付他在麵店打工時忙碌的午餐時段。

en: Lisa gave a flawless piano performance at the school concert without a single mistake.
exzh: Lisa 在學校音樂會上完美無瑕地演奏鋼琴，一個錯誤都沒有。

en: The population of our town is small, so everyone at the market knows each other.
exzh: 我們鎮上的人口很少，所以市場裡的人都互相認識。

en: Additionally, Amy washes all the dishes after she cooks dinner for her family.
exzh: 此外，Amy 為家人煮完晚餐後還會把所有碗盤洗好。

en: The narrow street near my grandmother's house is too small for big cars.
exzh: 我外婆家附近的那條窄街太窄，大型車開不進去。

en: The temperature dropped dramatically last night, so Kevin wore a thick coat to school.
exzh: 昨晚氣溫驟降，所以 Kevin 穿了厚外套去上學。

en: It was thoughtless of Ben to play loud music while his brother was studying.
exzh: Ben 在弟弟讀書時大聲放音樂，真是不體貼。

en: Lisa's family will rent a small house near the beach for their summer vacation.
exzh: Lisa 一家人暑假要在海邊附近租一間小房子。

en: Mr. Chen told us not to feel negative after one bad test score.
exzh: Mr. Chen 告訴我們不要因為一次考不好就感到消極。

en: Amy's widowed neighbor lives alone, so she often brings him soup on weekends.
exzh: Amy 那位喪偶的鄰居獨自生活，所以她週末常端湯給他喝。

en: When the ball flew toward her, Lisa instinctively raised her hands to catch it.
exzh: 球朝她飛來時，Lisa 本能地舉起雙手去接。

en: Our baseball team celebrated its first victory of the season with ice cream.
exzh: 我們的棒球隊吃冰淇淋慶祝本季的第一場勝利。

en: Kevin will definitely join the science fair because he loves building robots.
exzh: Kevin 一定會參加科學展覽，因為他很愛做機器人。

en: The primary reason Amy joined the swimming team was to get stronger.
exzh: Amy 加入游泳隊的主要原因是想變得更強壯。

en: After the rain, the vegetation on the hill near our school turned bright green.
exzh: 下過雨後，我們學校附近山丘上的草木變得翠綠。

en: Bubble tea from Taiwan is now a household name that people in many countries enjoy.
exzh: 台灣的珍珠奶茶如今已是家喻戶曉的名字，許多國家的人都愛喝。

en: Ben's uncle uses specialized tools to repair old watches in his small shop.
exzh: Ben 的叔叔在他的小店裡用專門的工具修理老手錶。

en: Lisa is a talented artist, and her posters always win prizes at school.
exzh: Lisa 是個很有才華的畫家，她的海報總是在學校得獎。

en: In media class, Mr. Chen taught us how the manipulation of photos can fool people online.
exzh: 在媒體課上，Mr. Chen 教我們修改照片的操弄手法如何欺騙網路上的人。

en: An advertiser paid our school radio club to read a short message about a new bookstore.
exzh: 一家廣告商付錢請我們學校的廣播社唸一則關於新書店的短訊息。

en: Kevin installed a tracker blocker on his laptop so websites couldn't follow what he searched.
exzh: Kevin 在筆電上安裝了追蹤阻擋器，讓網站無法追蹤他搜尋的內容。

en: Amy tried many hobbies, but ultimately she chose photography as her favorite.
exzh: Amy 嘗試過許多興趣，但最終她選了攝影當作最愛。

en: Ben became addicted to a phone game and forgot to finish his homework.
exzh: Ben 沉迷於一款手機遊戲，忘了寫完功課。

en: Rice and noodles are rich in carbohydrate, which gives Lisa energy for basketball practice.
exzh: 米飯和麵條富含碳水化合物，能給 Lisa 籃球練習所需的體力。

en: Mr. Chen reminded us to drink water so we would stay hydrated during sports day.
exzh: Mr. Chen 提醒我們要多喝水，運動會當天才能保持水分充足。

en: This board game is so complicated that Kevin needed twenty minutes to learn the rules.
exzh: 這款桌遊的規則太複雜，Kevin 花了二十分鐘才弄懂。

en: Amy wore a plain white T-shirt and jeans to the school picnic.
exzh: Amy 穿著簡單的白 T 恤和牛仔褲去參加學校野餐。

en: The penetrating sound of the fire alarm made everyone in the hallway cover their ears.
exzh: 火警鈴聲刺耳，讓走廊上的每個人都摀住了耳朵。

en: Ben's indecision about which club to join made him miss the sign-up deadline.
exzh: Ben 對要加入哪個社團猶豫不決，結果錯過了報名截止日。

zh: 引人入勝的；有說服力的
en: Lisa gave a compelling speech, and the whole class agreed to clean the park.
exzh: Lisa 發表了一場很有說服力的演講，全班都同意去打掃公園。

en: Mr. Wu has an unconventional way of teaching English, using songs and games in every class.
exzh: Mr. Wu 教英文的方式很不傳統，每堂課都用歌曲和遊戲。

en: Our teacher asked Amy to define the word energy in her own words.
exzh: 老師請 Amy 用自己的話為「能量」這個詞下定義。

en: The poster was misleading because it said the concert was free, but tickets cost money.
exzh: 那張海報很誤導人，因為它說音樂會免費，但門票其實要收費。

en: Kevin's science experiment was flawed because he forgot to measure the water first.
exzh: Kevin 的科學實驗有缺陷，因為他忘了先量水。

en: Mr. Chen asked us to check the validity of the news before sharing it with friends.
exzh: Mr. Chen 要我們在和朋友分享新聞前，先查證它的正確性。

en: Before writing her report, Lisa used library books to verify each fact.
exzh: 寫報告之前，Lisa 用圖書館的書來查證每一項事實。

en: A retired sailor visited our school and told us stories about his trips across the sea.
exzh: 一位退休的水手來到我們學校，講述他橫越大海的旅程。

en: Ben's English improved considerably after he read an article every morning.
exzh: Ben 每天早上讀一篇文章後，英文進步了相當多。

en: Taipei is densely populated, so the MRT is always full during rush hour.
exzh: 台北人口稠密，所以捷運在尖峰時段總是很擠。

en: We camped in a quiet valley where a small river ran beside our tents.
exzh: 我們在一個安靜的山谷裡露營，一條小河就流經帳篷旁邊。

en: Kevin and his cousin caught tiny fish in a clear stream near the village.
exzh: Kevin 和他的表哥在村子附近一條清澈的小溪裡捉小魚。

en: Amy noticed a stark difference between her crowded school and the quiet village school.
exzh: Amy 注意到她擁擠的學校和寧靜的鄉村學校之間有明顯的差異。

en: Lisa loves the bustling morning market where sellers shout and families buy fresh food.
exzh: Lisa 喜歡熱鬧的早市，那裡的攤販叫賣，家家戶戶都來買新鮮食物。

en: Mr. Chen told the class that copying a classmate's answers during an exam is unethical.
exzh: Mr. Chen 告訴全班，考試時抄同學的答案是不道德的。

en: Lisa's mother shared her concern about Lisa sleeping only five hours each night.
exzh: Lisa 的媽媽表達了對 Lisa 每晚只睡五小時的擔憂。

en: In biology class, we learned that identical twins are genetically almost the same.
exzh: 在生物課上，我們學到同卵雙胞胎在基因上幾乎完全相同。

en: Ben could join the art club or the chess club, and he chose the latter.
exzh: Ben 可以加入美術社或西洋棋社，他選了後者。

en: The blue shirt suits Kevin well, so his mom bought it for his birthday.
exzh: 那件藍色襯衫很適合 Kevin，所以他媽媽買來當他的生日禮物。

en: We rested by the tranquil lake and listened to the birds after the long hike.
exzh: 長途健行後，我們在寧靜的湖邊休息，聽著鳥叫聲。

en: Ben took Mr. Chen's idiom literally and looked outside for falling cats and dogs.
exzh: Ben 把 Mr. Chen 說的俗語照字面理解，跑到外面找從天上掉下來的貓和狗。

en: The elevation of Alishan is so high that Amy felt a little dizzy on the train.
exzh: 阿里山的海拔很高，Amy 在火車上覺得有點頭暈。

en: The school nurse said the incidence of colds rises when the weather suddenly gets cold.
exzh: 護理師說，天氣突然變冷時，感冒的發生率會上升。

en: A strong wind swept through the playground and blew away our paper signs.
exzh: 一陣強風掃過操場，吹走了我們的紙板標語。

en: Our class helped with the segregation of recycling into paper, plastic, and glass bins.
exzh: 我們班幫忙把資源回收分開放進紙類、塑膠和玻璃的回收桶。

en: Grandma's mobility improved after she did gentle exercises in the park every morning.
exzh: 外婆每天早上在公園做輕鬆的運動後，行動能力改善了。

en: Lisa won the speech contest because of her eloquence and calm voice.
exzh: Lisa 憑著出色的口才和沉穩的聲音贏得了演講比賽。

en: Mr. Chen asked a rhetorical question about holidays, and nobody in the class answered it.
exzh: Mr. Chen 問了一個關於放假的修辭性問題，結果班上沒有人回答。
